parole.significato: Irritatingly pleased with oneself; offensively self-complacent, self-satisfied.
parole.testo: Originally "spruce, neat," from Low German smuk (“pretty”), from Middle Low German smuk (“lithe, delicate, neat, trim”), although the g of the English word is not easily explained.
